channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 03
item.description:
2 development commits

No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 02
item.description:
60 development commits

Sailing

  • Sail wind behavior is now fully server‑side, eliminating client/server mismatches and ensuring consistent wind effects on sailboats.

Livestock & Animals

  • Livestock breeding rebalanced: bond time increased to 15 min, reproduction blocked until full bond, population capped at 300 per species, new "livestock.cullexcess" command to cull excess, and "livestock.breedOnlyAtHome" convar to restrict breeding near a player’s TC.
  • Cows no longer unfreeze their needs or age incorrectly when bonded, fixing livestock stat inconsistencies.

Deployables

  • Halloween string lights are now deployable again.

Server & Stability

  • Modded servers are now correctly tagged and will no longer crash before fully starting.

World & Environment

  • Water now correctly appears in underground and underwater lab areas, restoring expected water physics and visual cues.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 01
item.description:
89 development commits

Input & UI

  • Fixed continuous input failures caused by mis‑detected Steam input at startup.
  • Fixed gamepad cursor state handling.
  • Sleeping bag placement range guide now updates correctly when its configuration values change.
  • Pie menu now correctly updates option names and descriptions, removing stale placeholder text.

Livestock & Animals

  • Improved livestock behavior: reduced clipping when leading multiple animals or at troughs, prevented attacks on players inside vehicles, fixed collisions with travelling vendors, resolved various bull and ram issues (head‑butting, charging glitches, animation errors), and stopped cows from sliding unexpectedly. Livestock also can no longer be damaged inside safe zones.
  • Jungle plants now receive proper groundwater, fixing the previous lack of water for terrain‑placed flora.

Combat & Weapons

  • Fixed rifle orientation while sprinting and added sprint speed modifiers to specific rifles (med, jungle, diver AKs).
  • Minicrossbow now plays only the necessary reload animation during partial reloads in 3‑person mode.

Structures & Interaction

  • Fixed a potential crash caused by a NullReferenceException in lock loading logic.
  • Corrected biofuel generator placement so it no longer snaps backwards when placed.

DLC Content

  • Added the electronic chessboard DLC, including split game model, chess and checkers pieces, and updated deployable prefab.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Water jugs are now classified as Items, restoring the ability to recycle them and allowing storage in fridges and minifridges.

Quality of Life

  • The quick join menu now correctly refreshes, ensuring players see up‑to‑date server listings.
